purpose: Teach: 買い手/忠告/転用/模範/必読/預かっ/コーディネート/休養

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、盗難品、買い手の特定、本当に、難航しております、警察、全力で、捜査、進めております、皆様、ご協力、お願いいたします、本当に、急務、感じております。
lines.en: This theft case — identifying the buyer has proven difficult. The police department is pursuing this investigation with full force, and we're asking for your cooperation. This is genuinely urgent.
lines.style: Measured official tone. Steady breathing. Slight pause before each key point—"theft," "buyer," "urgent." Formal but human. Not rushed despite the gravity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察様からの忠告、社員に、しっかり、伝えております、本当に、防犯意識、高まっております、社内、皆様の、おかげで、本当に、感謝。
lines.en: Yes. We've made sure to communicate the police's guidance to all our employees. Security awareness has genuinely increased across the company, and that's thanks to everyone here. We're truly grateful.
lines.style: Respectful, measured. A touch of quiet pride in the team effort. Deliberate pacing on "thanks to everyone." Warm but formal. The tone of someone representing the group.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 捜査手法、新しい技術、転用させていただいております、本件、最新の科学捜査、活用しております、市民の安全、第一です、本当に。
lines.en: We're adapting new investigative techniques and applying the latest forensic science methods to this case. The safety of our citizens comes first—that's our priority.
lines.style: Professional, calm. Deliberate enunciation on "forensic" and "priority." Even pace, unrushed. The authority of someone who knows the procedures and believes in them.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察の対応、本当に、模範的で、社員、感心しております、本当に、頼りに、なる存在です、地域として、本当に、感謝、しております、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. The police's response has been exemplary. Our employees have been impressed by it. You've been someone we can truly rely on. As a community, we're genuinely grateful for everything.
lines.style: Warm formality. Slight emphasis on "exemplary" and "rely on." Steady, appreciative. The tone of someone speaking on behalf of their workplace, meaning each word.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察学校の必読書、私も、若い頃、徹底的に、勉強いたしました、本当に、勉強、続けないと、いけませんね、警察官として、絶対に、本当に、絶えず。
lines.en: The mandatory readings from police academy—I studied them thoroughly when I was young. You have to keep studying, you know. As a police officer, it never stops. Never.
lines.style: Reflective, almost conversational despite formality. A quiet weight on "when I was young." Slight emphasis on the repeated "never"—not driven, but deeply grounded. Speaking from lived experience.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察からの、お預かった、重要書類、本当に、慎重に、保管しております、絶対、外部に、漏らさないよう、徹底中、本当に、社員、皆。
lines.en: Yes. We're storing the important documents the police entrusted to us with great care. We're being thorough about making sure nothing leaks outside. Everyone on staff is committed to that.
lines.style: Earnest and attentive. Deliberate pacing on "care" and "thorough." The seriousness of someone protecting something they've been asked to guard. Steady, no slips.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 防犯活動、地域全体で、コーディネートしてまいります、本当に、皆様の、お力、必要です、地域の、安全、共に、守ってまいりましょう、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: We'll be coordinating community-wide crime prevention efforts moving forward. We'll need your help and support. Let's work together to protect our community's safety.
lines.style: Clear and inclusive. Rising slight energy on "together." Professional but warm—the tone of someone inviting collaboration, not issuing orders. Strong but open.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察官の方々の、休養、本当に、しっかり、取られてほしいですね、本当に、お疲れ様です、いつも、感謝、申し上げます、地域として、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. I hope you officers are taking proper rest and time off. Thank you for everything you do for us. We appreciate you so much, truly. As a community, we're grateful for your service.
lines.style: Warm, genuine concern underneath the formality. Slight softening on "rest." The appreciation is sincere, not perfunctory. Speaking from the heart while remaining respectful.
